protocol_metadata.about: Stake DAO is a decentralized platform that enables users to maximize the value of governance tokens through Liquid Lockers, which lock tokens for governance and issue liquid sdTokens in return. The protocol operates across 10 chains and provides yield optimization through integrated Strategies that leverage veToken balances, supplemented by Votemarket (governance vote marketplace) and veSDT governance token mechanics. SDT token holders govern the DAO and vote on reward allocation and protocol upgrades.
